import json
import pathlib
import sqlite3

connection = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
setup = "CREATE TABLE stock (sku TEXT, quantity INTEGER); INSERT INTO stock VALUES ('DEMO-1', 3);"
try:
    connection.execute(setup)
except sqlite3.ProgrammingError as error:
    rejected = str(error)
else:
    raise AssertionError('execute unexpectedly accepted multiple statements')

assert connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE name = 'stock'").fetchone() == (0,)
connection.executescript(setup)
rows = connection.execute('SELECT sku, quantity FROM stock ORDER BY sku').fetchall()
assert rows == [('DEMO-1', 3)], rows
connection.close()
report = {'sqlite_version': sqlite3.sqlite_version, 'input_sql': setup, 'execute_error': rejected, 'table_absent_after_rejection': True, 'executescript_then_select_rows': rows}
out = pathlib.Path('products/services/sqlite-editorial-baseline/python-api-exercise.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
